command_format.unit: F0; F0 is configured motion-charge acceleration [C/s^2]

inverse_drive_matrix_format.packing: Re00,Re01,Re10,Re11,Im00,Im01,Im10,Im11; lane0 in least significant bits

stage_boundaries: Fc/Fs after direction projection to fractional16

timing.command_update: atomic snapshot; same-edge sample consumes previous snapshot
timing.sample_output: registered at sample_en rising edge; testbench observes after nonblocking updates
timing.sample_id: trusted external 40kHz sample counter modulo2^32; forward distances must be less than2^31
timing.freshness: unsigned(sample_id-command_source_sample)<=80, inclusive; future timestamps rejected under bounded distance assumption

invalid_sample_action: emit zero DAC codes at the sample transaction, drive_active=0, clip flags=0; reset emits no transaction
validation_dependencies: unit direction and coherent sin/cos guaranteed upstream
calibration_valid is an upstream authorization, not a calibration estimator
NCO phase follows actual sample epoch
M already contains declared driver/ZOH compensation; do not compensate twice
scope: static direction held per command; no heading prediction, NCO generation, PI/PLL, ADC deembedding, navigation or physical closed-loop safety claim
